text: Program Description: The public health specialty is based on the policy of "prevention mainly", exploring the relationship between human disease and health related problems (such as social, psychological, environmental and other factors related to disease and health) from the point of view of the group, preventing the occurrence of disease, controlling the development of the disease and promoting health. And it is closely related to many disciplines such as management, economics, law and so on. On the one hand, chronic diseases such as hypertension and diabetes, such as hypertension and diabetes, have seriously threatened people's health and life safety. On the other hand, infectious diseases are still a great threat to human beings, such as the increase of the incidence of AIDS and the unexpected pneumonia. People have put forward higher requirements for the demand and quality of public health services, and the development of public health has received unprecedented attention from the society. Training target It has the basic theoretical knowledge of public health and preventive medicine. It has a certain working ability in disease control, health supervision, health management, general science, rehabilitation medicine, medical nutrition and so on. It can be engaged in teaching and science related institutions related to public health schools, scientific research units and public health students. Senior medical professionals in research and other public health professions. Future Career: The institutions that can be employed are: the Centers for disease prevention and control at all levels, the health supervision institute, the health administration, the inspection and Quarantine Bureau, the customs, the medical and maternal and child health care centers, the Health Education Institute, the medical college and the related research institutions. Duration: 5 yeaes
